name: G90
subtitle: Field reference
kicker: Independent reference. Not a Xiegu publication and not affiliated with Xiegu.
verified: Compiled from the Xiegu G90 Operation Manual version 1.00.01, September 2026. Not checked against a radio. The manual documents no reset and no repeater operation, so neither appears here.
specs: 20 W on SSB, CW and FM. 5 W AM carrier at 13.8 V. Set in 1 W steps
SL16-K, 50 ohms. This is the SO-239 family
Yes, built in, run from the TUNE key
COMM port, standard CI-V command set
Plus or minus 10 ppm after warm-up, 1 ppm per hour at 25 C
keys: Lights an F indicator, then press the target key for its second function. Press FUNC again to leave. Hold FUNC to open the system setup.
Cycles preamp, attenuator, and straight through.
Speech compression. With FUNC, the low-end cut of the digital filter.
Noise blanker. With FUNC, the high-end cut of the digital filter.
Cycles AGC off, slow, fast and auto. With FUNC, split.
Channel store. With FUNC, channel clear.
Swaps the VFOs. With FUNC, copies the current VFO to the background one.
Tap puts the tuner in line. Hold starts a tuning cycle.
Transmit power. With FUNC, mic gain. See the note about the SWR sweep.
Standing wave protection threshold. With FUNC, audio input select.
Backlight brightness, five levels. With FUNC, the spectrum reference level. Hold to lock the panel.
Rotate to tune. Short press picks 100 Hz, 1 kHz or 10 kHz step.
Steps the 100 kHz digit by default. Hold to reassign it to squelch, power, keyer speed or display scale.
filters: Shaped by the low cut and high cut, reached with FUNC over the compression and blanker keys. Xiegu prints no bandwidth figures anywhere in the manual.
tasks: Press MW, rotate the main knob to the channel number, short press the main knob to commit.
Press VM to enter channel mode, then rotate the main knob.
FUNC then MW for clear mode, rotate to the channel, press the main knob.
Set the receive frequency and mode on VFO A, the transmit frequency on VFO B, then FUNC and the AGC key.
Short press Po, then rotate the multifunction knob. One watt per step.
Short press TUNE to bring it in line. Hold TUNE about a second to start tuning.
notes: Twenty watts from a radio this size is generous, and eight amps key down is the price. Fuse and wire for eight, not for what you usually run.
The manual contradicts itself over the second function of the power key: one section gives mic gain, another gives the antenna sweep. Try it once at home and write down which one your radio does.
There is no receive scan on this radio. The only sweep it has is a standing wave sweep of the antenna.
Two entries in Xiegu's manual read 'to be determined'. The CW auto pager needs the GSOC controller and does nothing on a bare radio.
Without the CE-19 expansion there is no band data output, so an amplifier will not follow the radio.
Xiegu's manual describes no repeater offset, shift, tone or tone squelch for this radio. It has FM but no documented repeater support, so nothing about working a repeater appears on this card.
settings: Filter low cut and high cut
control: COMM, using the standard CI-V command set
Xiegu's manual states none. Find yours and write it below.
ACC, 8-pin mini DIN, for computer audio in and out
Headphone, key, and an I and Q output, all 3.5 mm
The CE-19 adds PTT and band signal output, audio in and out, and data output on narrow FM
